# Andrew Cohen participates in NYU Center on Civil Justice panel


- Case law & ethics


October 28, 2024


-
-
-
-


*The American Lawyer* reports on an NYU Center on Civil Justice panel whose members included[Andrew Cohen](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/andrew-cohen/) , in an article entitled "Secrecy Or Prejudice: Panelists Debate Transparency in Litigation Funding Arrangements."


Cohen and fellow panelists discussed the potential impacts of legislation addressing legal finance disclosure.


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.law.com/americanlawyer/2024/10/28/secrecy-or-prejudice-panelists-debate-transparency-in-litigation-financing-arrangements/)
